usages.explain: Almost synonymous with "じつは" (actually), but less commonly used as an introductory phrase in cases of request or reliance. Often used when confiding or when asked for reasons or explanations.

examples.content: 実を言うと、私は彼女が好きじゃない。
examples.transcription: みをいうと、わたしはかのじょがすきじゃない。
examples.mean: To tell you the truth, I don't like her.

examples.content: 実を言うと、彼らは夫婦じゃない。
examples.transcription: みをいうと、かれらはふうふじゃない。
examples.mean: To tell the truth, they are not a couple.

usages.synopsis: 実を言うと（じつをいうと）～

title: じつをいうと => Frankly speaking
